Class NineAxisMotionShield

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.imu.NineAxisMotionShield
public final class NineAxisMotionShield extends Object
The Bosch BNO055 orientation sensor of the Arduino 9 Axis Motion Shield, read over I2C as plain Java on top of I2c (so it needs no Arduino library). The sensor fuses its accelerometer and gyroscope itself and reports the heading in degrees; this class runs it in the IMU fusion mode, where the heading is relative to the direction the sensor pointed at power-up or at begin(), needs no compass calibration and is not disturbed by magnetic fields. That suits measuring how far a vehicle has turned: 
int start = NineAxisMotionShield.headingDegrees();
// ... turn left until NineAxisMotionShield.turnedSince(start) <= -90 (heading grows clockwise)

The shield's BNO055 answers at address 0x28; the 0x29 variant is selected with begin(int). Works on both boards, wherever Wire reaches the shield's SDA/SCL.

  • Method Details

    • begin

      public static boolean begin()
      Starts the sensor at ADDRESS_DEFAULT; see begin(int).

    • begin

      public static boolean begin(int sensorAddress)
      Starts the I2C bus and the sensor at sensorAddress in IMU fusion mode, returning false if no BNO055 answered. Waits for the sensor to boot, so call it once at startup.

    • headingRaw

      public static int headingRaw()
      The heading in sixteenths of a degree, 0..5759, growing clockwise; -1 if the read failed.

    • headingDegrees

      public static int headingDegrees()
      The heading in whole degrees, 0..359, growing clockwise; -1 if the read failed.

    • pitchRaw

      public static int pitchRaw()
      The pitch in sixteenths of a degree, signed, 0 when the sensor's board is level; the sign follows the BNO055's own convention (see its datasheet) and flips with the board's mounting. Short.MIN_VALUE if the read failed. This is the tilt a self-balancing robot rocks about when the shield is mounted with its X axis along the wheel axle.

    • gyroXRaw

      public static int gyroXRaw()
      The angular rate about the X axis in sixteenths of a degree per second, signed, taken from the gyroscope; the derivative of pitchRaw() without the delay of differencing it. Short.MIN_VALUE if the read failed.

    • turnedSince

      public static int turnedSince(int startDegrees)
      How far the heading has moved since startDegrees (from headingDegrees()), as a signed angle -180..180: positive clockwise, negative anticlockwise (a left turn). Handles the wrap around 360. Returns 0 if the read failed.

    • calibration

      public static int calibration()
      The calibration state, 2 bits each for the system (bits 6-7), gyroscope (4-5), accelerometer (2-3) and magnetometer (0-1), where 3 is fully calibrated; -1 if the read failed. In IMU mode only the gyroscope and accelerometer matter, and the gyroscope calibrates on its own while the sensor stands still for a moment.
